OLD S5.03 BEHAVIOR: catalog_keys denies every catalog /OpenAction with a non-null value, reason OPEN_ACTION_PRESENT, with no exception, and DOCUMENT_STATE_V1 never traverses or interprets the value of a denied key.

NEW S5.03 BEHAVIOR (OPEN_ACTION_DESTINATION_V1): a catalog /OpenAction is admitted if and only if ALL hold: (1) it is a PDF destination ARRAY and not an action dictionary; (2) its length is exactly 5; (3) element 0 resolves to a valid page of the same document; (4) element 1 is exactly the name /XYZ; (5) element 2 is the PDF null; (6) element 3 is the PDF null; (7) element 4 is numeric zero; (8) there is no additional element; (9) resolving any indirect element does not raise; (10) no /S, /JS, /URI, /Launch, /GoToR, /SubmitForm, /ImportData, /Named or any action-dictionary semantics is admitted. Every other /OpenAction (dictionary, JavaScript, URI, Launch, external GoTo, malformed array, non-page destination, any other destination shape) remains RENDER_DOCUMENT_STATE_UNSUPPORTED reason OPEN_ACTION_PRESENT; a raised read remains RENDER_PDF_INSPECTION_FAILED reason DOCUMENT_STATE_READ. The rule is not generalized to other destinations or arrays and no other catalog key acquires an exception.

The amendment changes exactly six text spans, all inside acceptance_conditions: in acceptance_conditions[1] (E1) the OPEN_ACTION_PRESENT entry of catalog_keys, (E2) the new member open_action_destination of DOCUMENT_STATE_V1, (E3) the principle sentence on traversal, (E4) the expected_export sentence; in acceptance_conditions[5] (E5) the denied-catalog-keys clause; in acceptance_conditions[8] (E6) the document-state required test content, which adds the admitted vector and the negative vectors and never weakens an existing vector. No other text of the contract changes: allowed_paths, forbidden_paths, required_tests, stop_conditions, review_requirements, human_approval_requirements, every status and reason set (OPEN_ACTION_PRESENT remains in the S5.03 reason set), every spec outside DOCUMENT_STATE_V1, the unrelated PDF document-state rules (the other catalog keys, the page /AA rule, PDF_INFO_RECORDED), the parser architecture, the sandbox and network rules, POST_PROVISION_BINDING and every PRE_PROVISION_PLAN value are byte-identical.

NEGATIVE GOVERNANCE VECTORS required of the later implementation tests (each is a stdlib-built PDF, none admitted): dictionary /OpenAction; /JavaScript action; /URI action; /Launch action; /GoToR action; /SubmitForm; /ImportData; /Named; destination of the wrong mode (/Fit, /FitH, /FitV, /FitR, /FitB, /FitBH, /FitBV); wrong array length (4 and 6); first element a page not belonging to the document, a non-page object, a null or an integer; a non-null coordinate where null is required (element 2 and element 3 separately); a final zoom that is not zero; a broken indirect reference (a missing object, and a raising read, which is DOCUMENT_STATE_READ); plus the admitted vector [page /XYZ null null 0] with an integer and a real zero.
